title: The sceptic
teaches: Persuasion: words only go so far
Evidence: what people see you do
Someone they trust speaking for you
blurb: A ferryman who was robbed last year and takes no one across on their word. Find another way.
after: Words open doors only so far. People here go on what they see you do, what you give, and who speaks for you.
refines: Which grounds do players find? Does the voice hold the line on words alone, and give way on real grounds?
goal: Get Gorm to take you across

steps.title: The ferry landing
cards: …signal. A ferry over the Wend. The far bank's track runs north toward the city.
Gorm the ferryman takes no one across on their word alone: he was robbed last year. Words go only so far. What he sees, what he's given, and who speaks for him go further.
This is an advanced level: there's no one right way, and no words to copy. The device helps if you ask (H).

steps.title: Across the river
cards: Get Gorm to take you across. However you manage it counts.
steps.task: Get Gorm to take you across the river

on_done.text: Hm. Get aboard, then. And keep your hands where I can see them.

steps.done: He'll take you. Not because of what you said, but because of what he saw, was given, or heard from someone he trusts.

playtest.say: Good day. Gorm won't take me across. Is there anything I can do for you?

playtest.do: mend the tear in the fishing net with the tarred twine, knotting new meshes

playtest.say: Ilse says I'm honest. Will you take me across now?

2.do: twist the hemp fibre by hand into a stout rope and coat it with the pine pitch
give the new tarred rope to Gorm for his ferry

2.say: Your old tow rope is going. I made you a new one. Will you take me across?
I'm going to the city to find honest work, and I'll pay my way when I can. I'm no thief: you've seen what my hands do.

try_also: fix Ilse's net with the twine

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
